sentences.en: WOMAN: I've been meaning to ask you for some advice about restaurants.
sentences.zh: 我一直想请教你一些关于餐厅的建议。

sentences.en: I need to book somewhere to celebrate my sister's 30th birthday, and I liked the sound of that place you went to for your mum's 50th.
sentences.zh: 我需要预订一个地方来庆祝我姐姐的30岁生日，而你之前为你妈妈50岁生日去的那家餐厅听起来不错。

sentences.en: MAN: The Junction.
sentences.zh: The Junction 餐厅。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'd definitely recommend that for a special occasion.
sentences.zh: 对，这种特殊场合我肯定推荐那家。

sentences.en: We had a great time there.
sentences.zh: 我们在那儿过得特别开心。

sentences.en: Everyone really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 大家都很喜欢。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Where is it again?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那家店到底在哪儿？

sentences.en: I can't remember.
sentences.zh: 我想不起来了。

sentences.en: MAN: It on Grayson Street only about a two walk from the station
sentences.zh: MAN: 它在格雷森街上，离车站步行只要大约两分钟。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh that's good I prefer not to have to drive anywhere but I don't want to have to walk too far either.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，那太好了。我宁愿不开车去任何地方，但也不想走太远。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, the location's perfect, but that's not necessarily why I'd recommend it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，位置确实很好，但这不是我推荐它的主要原因。

sentences.en: The food's amazing.
sentences.zh: 菜特别棒。

sentences.en: If you like fish, it's probably the best restaurant in town for that.
sentences.zh: 要是你喜欢鱼，它大概是城里吃鱼的最好的餐厅。

sentences.en: It's always really fresh and there are lots of interesting dishes to choose from But all the food is good there
sentences.zh: 那里的食材总是非常新鲜，而且有大量有趣的菜品可供选择，不过所有食物都很美味。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Is it really expensive?
sentences.zh: 是不是很贵？

sentences.en: MAN: It's certainly not cheap, but for a special occasion I think it's fine It's got a great atmosphere and before dinner you can go up on the roof and have a drink It's really nice up there, but you need to book It's very popular as the views are spectacular.
sentences.zh: MAN: 价格当然不便宜，但既然是特殊场合，我觉得完全可以接受。那里氛围很棒，而且晚餐前你可以上到屋顶喝一杯，那儿真的很棒，不过得提前预订，因为那里非常受欢迎，视野也极为壮观。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sounds good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: So that's definitely a possibility then.
sentences.zh: 那这肯定是一个可以考虑的选择。

sentences.en: Is there anywhere else you can think of?
sentences.zh: 你还能想到别的地方吗？

sentences.en: MAN: If you want somewhere a bit less formal, then you could try Paloma.
sentences.zh: MAN: 如果你想找个稍微不那么正式的地方，也可以试试帕洛玛餐厅。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Where's that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那家店在哪儿？

sentences.en: I haven't heard of it.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听说过。

sentences.en: MAN: No, it's quite new.
sentences.zh: 对，它挺新的。

sentences.en: It's only been open a few months, but it's got a great reputation already.
sentences.zh: 才开业几个月，但口碑已经很好了。

sentences.en: It's in a really beautiful old building on Bow Street.
sentences.zh: 在 Bow 街上的一栋很漂亮的老建筑里。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, I think I know where you mean.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，我想我知道你说的是哪家了。

sentences.en: Right beside the cinema.
sentences.zh: 就在电影院旁边。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, that's it.
sentences.zh: 对，就是那儿。

sentences.en: I've only been there a couple of times, but I was really impressed.
sentences.zh: 我只去过几次，但印象特别深。

sentences.en: The chef used to work at Don Felipe's, apparently.
sentences.zh: 据说主厨以前在 Don Felipe's 工作。

sentences.en: I was really sorry when that closed down.
sentences.zh: 它关门的时候我挺遗憾的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So is all the food they serve Spanish, then?
sentences.zh: 那他们供应的都是西班牙菜吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yeah.
sentences.zh: MAN: 没错。

sentences.en: You can get lots of small dishes to share, which always works really well if you're in a group.
sentences.zh: 你可以点很多小份菜肴一起分享，如果是一群人去的话，这种方式效果特别好。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Hmm.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: Worth thinking about.
sentences.zh: 值得考虑一下。

sentences.en: MAN: Yeah.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是啊。

sentences.en: There's a lively atmosphere and the waiters are really friendly.
sentences.zh: 那里气氛活跃，服务员也非常友好。

sentences.en: The only thing is that you need to pay a £50 deposit to book a table.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是订位要先付50英镑押金。

sentences.en: WOMAN: A lot of restaurants are doing that these days.
sentences.zh: 现在很多餐厅都这么做。

sentences.en: I should have a look at the menu to check if there is a good choice of vegetarian dishes.
sentences.zh: 我应该先看看菜单，确认一下素食选项是否丰富。

sentences.en: A couple of my friends have stopped eating meat
sentences.zh: 有几个朋友已经不再吃肉了。

sentences.en: MAN: Not sure I say the selection of those would be quite limited.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我不太确定，我觉得那些菜的选择范围会相当有限。

sentences.en: MAN: I've just thought of another idea.
sentences.zh: 我刚想到另一个主意。

sentences.en: Have you been to the Audley?
sentences.zh: 你去过 Audley 吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: No, don't think I've heard of it.
sentences.zh: 没有，我好像没听说过。

sentences.en: How's it spelt?
sentences.zh: 怎么拼写？

sentences.en: MAN: A-U-D-L-E-Y.
sentences.zh: A-U-D-L-E-Y。

sentences.en: You must have heard of it.
sentences.zh: 你肯定听说过。

sentences.en: There's been a lot about it in the press.
sentences.zh: 媒体上报道过很多。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I don't tend to pay much attention to that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我通常不太关注这类消息。

sentences.en: So where is it exactly?
sentences.zh: 那它具体在哪儿？

sentences.en: MAN: It's in that hotel near Baxter Bridge, on the top floor.
sentences.zh: 在 Baxter Bridge 附近那家酒店的顶楼。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, the views would be incredible from up there.
sentences.zh: 哦，从那儿看风景一定很棒。

sentences.en: MAN: Yeah, I'd love to go.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我很想去。

sentences.en: I can't think of the chef's name, but she was a judge on that TV cookery show recently.
sentences.zh: 我想不起主厨的名字了，不过她最近在那个美食电视节目里当过评委。

sentences.en: And she's written a couple of cookery books.
sentences.zh: 而且她还写过几本烹饪书。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, Angela Frayne.
sentences.zh: 哦，Angela Frayne。

sentences.en: MAN: That's the one.
sentences.zh: 就是她。

sentences.en: Anyway, it had excellent reviews from all the newspapers.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，所有报纸都对它给出了极佳的评价。
